gather_resource.labor: as a number, the people dedicated to the task
gather_resource.resource: the resource to be gathered, valid IDs - 'food'; 'wood'; 'stone;
gather_resource.tool: the ID of the tool, or 'null', used

construct.scale: as an integer, the size of the structure
construct.name: the name of the building
construct.is_key: if the building is noteworthy enough to be listed as a key building for the settlement
construct.location: the place where the construction is taking place

establish_settlement.scale: the size of the outpost: 1 being a small forward base, 10 being a large city
establish_settlement.population: the number of people in the city
key_buildings: the main productive buildings in the city

change_empire_name.new_name: the new name of the empire

change_empire_relation.target_empire: the empire whose relation to the player's has changed
change_empire_relation.value: as an integer, the value to increase/decrease (+/-) by, points ranging from total 0-100: from 0 (mortal enemies) to 100 (best of friends/allies)

explore.scale: as an integer, the radius around the origin explored
explore.origin: the place the exploration starts from

send_other_empire_message.intent: one of the following: greeting; threat; warning; request; insult; apology; negotiation

propose_alliance.other_empire: the empire the alliance is proposed to

declare_war.other_empire: the empire that is being declared war on

offer_peace.other_empire: the empire that peace is being offered to

offer_trade.other_empire: the empire the trade is being offered to

resources_offered.amount: as an integer, the number of resource offered
as an integer, the number of second resource offered

resources_requested.amount: as an integer, the number of resource requested
as an integer, the second number of resource requested

general_action.catagory: the type of action to the best definition possible at minimum word count
general_action.intent: the summarized intent at minimum word count
